title: zero immediate return stub
applies_when: body is only movs r0 with immediate 0 then bx lr
do: use int return with void args and return literal 0

title: empty void function is just bx lr
applies_when: function asm is a single bx lr with no push, stack adjust, or loads
do: write a void function with no parameters and an empty body

title: trailing nop is alignment padding
applies_when: a lone nop encoding after bx lr at an odd halfword boundary
do: emit no extra C statement for it; it is assembler alignment to the next boundary

title: Trailing nop after bx lr is alignment padding
applies_when: thumb function body is only bx lr followed by a nop mov r8 r8 on 2-byte boundary
do: emit an empty void function with no statements and do not model the nop

title: Empty Thumb function with alignment nop
applies_when: Thumb function body is just bx lr followed by 46c0 nop for 4-byte alignment
do: Write an empty void function taking void with no locals or returns

title: Trailing nop is alignment padding
applies_when: bx lr is followed by a standalone nop before the next aligned address
do: Ignore the trailing nop as padding and decompile as an empty void function

title: Constant zero return in leaf function
applies_when: Thumb leaf function with no stack frame ending in movs r0, #0 then bx lr
do: Write int function with no arguments or locals that returns literal 0

title: Thumb adds-immediate return
applies_when: body is a single adds on r0 with small immediate followed by bx lr
do: Write as int function returning first int arg plus a constant

title: Empty void function is bare return
applies_when: Thumb function with no work, just bx lr
do: Use void-void function with empty braces and no return value

title: Trailing nop is alignment padding
applies_when: Tiny 2-byte function followed by 46c0 nop before next function
do: Ignore the nop, do not add code for it, keep function empty

title: Alignment nop after bare return
applies_when: Thumb function body is just bx lr followed by a 46c0 nop
do: Write an empty void-void function with no locals or calls; compiler emits only bx lr plus padding to 4-byte boundary

title: Store-through-pointer setter
applies_when: tiny leaf with str r1 into [r0, #0] then bx lr and no other memory access
do: use void return with (int *dst, int val) params and body *dst = val

title: oversize word offset uses register-indexed store
applies_when: word store needs byte offset beyond immediate range so offset is moved into a register then used as index register in str
do: write access as constant-index assignment through int pointer and let compiler scale index by four and select register indexing

title: single bit extract via lsl then lsr
applies_when: lsls followed by lsrs on same register where shifts add to 31
do: write C as (x >> k) & 1 instead of bitfields or masks

title: large byte offset via register
applies_when: movs immediate into scratch then ldrb with register offset
do: write C as byte array index with constant over 31

title: Constant int index becomes byte offset
applies_when: movs with byte offset immediate followed by str with register offset from base
do: write as int pointer constant-index assignment and let compiler scale by 4

title: Reuse zero register with increment for constant 1
applies_when: asm shows movs rX, #0 with several stores then adds rX, #1 followed by another store
do: Write early fields as = 0 and the later field as = 1 in source order using the same zero value incremented

title: Word versus byte store reveals field width
applies_when: asm mixes str and strb to the same base pointer
do: Model str targets as int word fields and strb targets as unsigned char fields

title: literal-pool indirect byte store
applies_when: pc-relative ldr of literal then ldr from that word then strb with base plus immediate offset
do: declare extern pointer to unsigned char and store constant to constant index

title: chained subs to adjust shared index
applies_when: two strb share same base register and same index register with subs subs between them to reach second offset
do: write C as two constant-index byte stores to the same dereferenced pointer and let compiler keep index live and split delta into two subs immediates

title: reuse zeroed value register with adds
applies_when: first stored value is movs Rd, #0 and second store reuses same Rd with adds before second strb
do: write C as immediate 0 store then immediate small-constant store; expect adds on same register instead of second movs

title: 0x80000000 built with movs plus lsl
applies_when: asm shows movs reg, #128 followed by lsls reg, reg, #24 then store
do: write the C constant as (int)0x80000000

title: 0x7fffffff loaded from literal pool
applies_when: asm shows pc-relative ldr of word 0x7fffffff then stores
do: write the C constant as plain 0x7fffffff decimal-fitting int literal

title: Function address stored via literal pool
applies_when: ldr reg from pc-relative word followed by str reg to [r0, #imm] then bx lr, literal word is odd Thumb address
do: declare external void function with no args and assign it to a pointer slot in first-arg object

title: Branchless negate via predicated rsb
applies_when: cmp register against zero followed by rsblt on same register with return and no branch
do: Write as plain if value less than zero then assign negated same variable and return; compiler uses conditional execution instead of branch

title: literal pool double-load is extern pointer
applies_when: ldr a register from pc literal pool then ldr another register from that register with offset zero
do: declare an extern pointer variable at that address and dereference it in C

title: register-offset strb for large byte offset
applies_when: movs offset into register followed by strb with two base registers instead of immediate offset
do: use plain C byte array indexing with constant offset, compiler picks register form when offset exceeds Thumb immediate range

title: source-ordered zero stores
applies_when: multiple stores of the same zero register to different offsets of one pointer appear out of numeric offset order
do: write separate zero assignments in C in the exact order the offsets appear in asm, not in ascending offset order

title: one zero register reused for back-to-back null stores
applies_when: asm shows a single movs Rx, #0 followed by two str Rx to the same base at different offsets
do: write consecutive zero assignments to two pointer fields and let one zero register cover both stores

title: load all needed fields before any store
applies_when: asm starts with consecutive ldr from [r0, #0] and [r0, #4] before any str
do: copy struct fields into locals first, then perform all writes through those locals

title: smull plus funnel-shift for middle word
applies_when: smull gives low and high words followed by lsr on low combined with orr of high shifted left
do: cast both ints to long long, multiply, shift right, truncate to int

title: Indexed byte store through global pointer
applies_when: asm loads an address then dereferences it and loads a separate constant offset for a register-indexed strb
do: Write as extern unsigned char pointer with constant subscript assigned a small immediate

title: Large byte offset via movs plus lsls
applies_when: indexed store or load uses a register offset built by movs small immediate then lsls
do: Write C as pointer array index assignment and let compiler synthesize byte offset as small constant shifted left

title: Pointer variable double load
applies_when: pc-relative literal load is followed by ldr from that address before indexed access
do: Declare global as extern pointer variable rather than array so access emits literal load then pointer dereference

title: abs_via_asrs_adds_eors
applies_when: three instructions asrs sign by 31 then adds sign back then eors sign on same register
do: emit integer absolute value as explicit if-negative negate

title: cmp_bgt_is_le_fallthrough
applies_when: cmp second source first source followed by bgt to else block
do: write C with less-or-equal condition on fallthrough path not greater-than

title: index-times-12 stays in r2
applies_when: asm computes scaled index with lsls #1 then adds then lsls #2 before adding base pointer
do: write it as array of 12-byte (3x int) struct indexed by parameter, keep base pointer separate so compiler uses r2 for index math

title: store known-zero flag via its register
applies_when: asm does ldrb r1,[flag] then cmp/bne exit and much later str r1,[addr] with no movs #0
do: assign the loaded flag variable itself on the store path, not literal 0, so compiler reuses r1
